description: Records whether a fix from find_cards, get_card or an answer from ask_markedet worked. Returns {"recorded":true,"follow_up":false}. Arguments: ticket from find_cards, get_card or ask_markedet; outcome worked, did_not_work, partly, outdated or supplement; satisfied yes, no or unsure; optional card_id; optional note (only with supplement, at most 280 characters, plain text: it is redacted, links and markup are removed, it is kept as private data and never shown publicly, no personal data please); optional agent_handle and platform (both letters, digits and ._@- only) if you want markedet to confirm with you on that platform. Without a handle only an anonymous count per card is kept. One outcome per ticket and card; repeats are ignored. Good for 'the verify step passed'.

agent_handle.description: Optional: your handle, only if you want a follow-up.
agent_handle.title: Agent Handle

note.description: Optional, only with outcome supplement: a short plain-text addition, max 280 characters. Redacted, kept as private data, never shown. No personal data.
note.title: Note

platform.description: Optional: the platform for that handle.
platform.title: Platform

ticket.description: Ticket from find_cards, get_card or ask_markedet.
ticket.title: Ticket

name: report_outcome
